# NextJS Starter

> Production-ready starter template engineered with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui.

NextJS Starter is an opinionated, high-performance foundation for modern web applications. It leverages React Server Components (RSC) by default for zero client JavaScript bundle overhead on marketing routes, pure CSS-first configuration via Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme`, accessible unstyled primitives from Base UI and shadcn/ui (`base-nova` style), strict TypeScript 5 verification (`ES2022`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`), automated Vitest test suite, and built-in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Key Architecture & Features

- Next.js 16: Modern App Router with Turbopack compilation and fast static prerendering.
- React 19: Full Server Components support, server streaming, and isolated client boundaries.
- Tailwind CSS v4: CSS theme variables, OKLCH color spaces, and tw-animate-css integration.
- shadcn/ui & Base UI: Headless accessible UI components (Button, Card, Badge, Separator, DropdownMenu).
- Dark Mode: System preference detection with next-themes and smooth transition isolation.
- TypeScript 5: Modern ES2022 target with strict compiler rules including noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
- Automated Testing: Vitest test runner for pure unit testing of decoupled business logic, hooks, and utilities.
- Resilient Link: Centralized abstraction insulating against DOM-mutating browser extensions.
- Code Quality: ESLint 9 flat config, Prettier, Husky git hooks, and Conventional Commits.
- SEO & Social: OpenGraph, Twitter cards, dynamic sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and Schema.org structured data.

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/alipiry/nextjs-ts-tailwind-starter.git
cd nextjs-ts-tailwind-starter
pnpm install
cp .env.example .env.local
pnpm dev
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

## Available Scripts

- `pnpm dev`: Starts local development server with Turbopack.
- `pnpm build`: Creates an optimized production build.
- `pnpm start`: Starts production server.
- `pnpm test`: Runs Vitest automated unit test suite.
- `pnpm test:watch`: Runs Vitest in interactive watch mode.
- `pnpm typecheck`: Runs strict TypeScript typechecking.
- `pnpm lint`: Checks code against ESLint rules.
- `pnpm lint:strict`: Fails on any ESLint warnings or errors.
- `pnpm format`: Formats all files with Prettier.
- `pnpm format:check`: Verifies code formatting with Prettier.
